description: A Viet Nam energy-system collection republishes the land-use map used to prepare the 2018 Viet Nam Biomass Atlas. The provider cites the World Bank and ESMAP Energydata.info release and identifies this item as a raster. Zenodo lists a public 213 MB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. Land-use classes could constrain biomass siting, grid-route placement or competing agricultural and energy-system land demands in a spatial simulation. This is a derived map for one atlas workflow, not an up-to-date legal zoning register or a complete land-rights source. The page does not provide a class legend, cell size, source imagery date or accuracy assessment. Its relation to the full biomass atlas is documented, but the two deposits have distinct files and simulation uses. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this map. The archive was not downloaded, so projection, classes and completeness remain unverified, and upstream map rights were not independently resolved.
